# [PR #19559] [None][fix] Guard model_engine access in PyExecutor._handle_responses

## 正文

## Dev Engineer Review

`_handle_responses` now safely accesses `model_engine.route_capture` with nested `getattr`. This prevents `AttributeError` for minimal `PyExecutor` instances while preserving route attachment when available. The file also contains broad import-formatting changes with no stated behavior change.

## QA Engineer Review

No test changes.

## Per-File QA Perspective

- `tensorrt_llm/_torch/pyexecutor/py_executor.py`: Verify response handling with and without `model_engine`, including completed requests with route capture enabled. Confirm route attachment remains unchanged for normal executors.
<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Description

Commit 5982425ca8 (#18397, Router Replay) added a `route_capture = getattr(self.model_engine, ...)` lookup in `PyExecutor._handle_responses`. Unlike the other `route_capture` call sites in the same commit, this one does not guard the `model_engine` attribute itself. #19478 later merged unit tests that construct a minimal `PyExecutor` (via `object.__new__`) without a `model_engine` attribute, so main now deterministically fails these two unit tests:

- `unittest/_torch/disaggregation/test_disagg_coordinator_errors.py::test_refused_python_cancel_is_retried_and_settled_through_the_real_response_path`
- `unittest/_torch/disaggregation/test_disagg_coordinator_errors.py::test_cancelling_part_of_a_saturated_receive_batch_settles_only_those_requests`

with:

```
tensorrt_llm/_torch/pyexecutor/py_executor.py: in _handle_responses
    route_capture = getattr(self.model_engine, "route_capture", None)
E   AttributeError: 'PyExecutor' object has no attribute 'model_engine'
```

The fix mirrors the guarded pattern the same commit already uses elsewhere in this file: `getattr(getattr(self, "model_engine", None), "route_capture", None)`.

## Test Coverage

The two unit tests above (already in `l0` CPU coverage) exercise this exact code path and fail on current main without this change.
